description: The plot illustrates training loss as a function of iteration for six model variants listed in the legend (Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128)). The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 140,000 with regularly spaced tick labels every 20,000 iterations. The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at 0.1 intervals. Each series is drawn as a solid line with a semi-transparent band around it; the Vanilla curve is purple, StrmLLM (n=64) is blue, SepLLM (n=64) is orange, SepLLM (n=64, H) is green, SepLLM (n=64, H/T) is red, and SepLLM (n=128) is dark blue. All lines drop steeply near the start (from around 3.4 at iteration 0) and then decrease more gradually toward the end of the x-range: by about 140,000 iterations, the StrmLLM (n=64) blue line is near ~2.61, the SepLLM (n=64) orange line near ~2.52, the SepLLM (n=64, H) green line near ~2.51, the SepLLM (n=64, H/T) red line near ~2.50, the SepLLM (n=128) dark-blue line near ~2.49, and the Vanilla purple line near ~2.47, with no visible upward spikes and only small fluctuations within the shaded bands throughout.
